verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a CLI and SaaS tool like Ardent, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out: no environment variable, config flag, or setting. The architecture note that only metadata flows to the control plane describes data-plane separation, not a user opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
